spellbook.finance/limitations: errorCode returned_package_reship_address_missing means neither the pull lines nor a parsed packing slip hold a usable buyer address for that order. Ask the person for the address on the marketplace order page and send it as correctedDestination.
errorCode returned_package_corrected_address_required means the case was recorded with returnReason address_issue, so the old address is never reused.
errorCode returned_package_reship_marketplace_unsupported means the order sold on a marketplace other than ManaPool or TCGplayer. The reship file covers those two.
Without correctedDestination, the address comes from the pull lines first and the parsed packing slip second. A packing-slip address is always country US with no second address line.
weightBasis presumed_intact means the weight assumes every card packed for the order is still in the envelope. Nobody checked the contents.

already_prepared means this key and case were prepared before, and the stored row is returned. A retry that changes only the spacing or letter case of the address counts as the same request. A new key prepares the case again.
The case stays held until spellbook_returned_package_reship_tracking records the new tracking number.
The returns workflow sits behind feature flag seller_returned_packages_v1, which is on for every account today. Error feature_disabled means the flag is off for this account.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

annotations.title: Prepare a reship for a returned package

description: Prepare the reship of returned packages recorded with spellbook_returned_package_record. Pass each caseId, with correctedDestination when the address on file is wrong or missing. Returns one row per case with the destination address, card count, computed weight in ounces and shipping bucket (pwe, parcel or international). The seller buys a new label from that row. It buys no label, moves no money and touches no marketplace. After the seller buys the label, call spellbook_returned_package_reship_tracking with the new tracking number.

cases.description: Up to 50 cases to prepare. Required, at least one.

caseId.description: The caseId from spellbook_returned_package_record, or from returnCase in spellbook_returned_package_lookup. Required.

correctedDestination.description: The address to reship to, from the marketplace order page. Required when the case's returnReason is address_issue. Omit it to reuse the stored address. A TCGplayer order stores its address on the parsed packing slip. When sent, it replaces the stored address.

addressLine2.description: The apartment, unit or suite line. Omit when there is none.

buyerName.description: The recipient's name as it goes on the label. Required.

country.description: The two-letter country code, such as US. Required.

postalCode.description: The ZIP or postal code. Required.

region.description: The state or region code, such as CA. Required.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you choose for this batch. Required. Send the same key and cases on a retry after a timeout to read the first result back.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the orders, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare
